Development work for PBI 1869339, using the development-agent ecosystem. Follow the parent's scope and the accepted desktop-parity baseline.

Development-only estimate

  • Original Estimate: 27 hours. Initial Remaining Work: 27 hours. Completed Work: 0.
  • Includes implementation, developer unit/component tests, developer self-checks and changes required by code review.
  • Excludes QA execution, QA regression, manual acceptance testing and QA effort. These belong in a separate Task and are not included here. A later review of defects may require updating development Remaining Work; do not charge QA work to this Task.
  • Estimated unassisted development portion: 36 hours. A provisional 25% reduction for ecosystem-assisted development yields 27 hours. The development/QA allocation and productivity adjustment are planning assumptions, not measured team results; recalibrate after the first comparable completed Tasks.
  • Parent Story Points cover broader PBI effort and remain unchanged. Do not add this Task's hours to SP-derived hours as additional scope, or treat Task completion as QA acceptance.

Development plan

  1. Load current parent requirements, repository-specific knowledge and desktop code. Identify ready scope, dependencies and unresolved questions before coding.
  2. Implement the confirmed scope through the ecosystem workflow. Reuse the shared editor, domain models, named-range and lock-aware save contracts where applicable; preserve unknown behavior as questions.
  3. Add developer-owned unit/component tests for the implemented behavior and persistence contracts. Run the relevant build, static checks and developer tests; fix implementation issues and code-review findings.
  4. Record the code revision, developer test evidence, known limitations and setup/data needed for the separate QA Task. Hand off the implementation for QA without claiming that the PBI has passed QA.

Boundaries

No additional functionality is authorized by this Task. General editor foundation, migration and deployment work remain outside this Task when separately scoped. Creating this Task does not start product implementation.

The current PBI has 12 SP (48 total hours). A provisional 36-hour development share is used here; the earlier 24 SP draft is not used. Both Date and Formula Range remain in scope. Reconcile the reduced PBI budget during analysis and revise development Remaining Work if both parts do not fit.
